description: This file contains functions and types related to access control policies for direct messages, including allowlist resolution, group access decision logic, and store reading functions.

methods.name: resolvePinnedMainDmOwnerFromAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves the main direct message owner from an allowlist, considering normalization and scope.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveAllowFromLists
methods.description: Computes effective allowlist entries for DM and group policies based on inputs and fallbacks.

methods.name: readStoreAllowFromForDmPolicy
methods.description: Reads allow-from entries from a store for a given DM policy, with optional fallback.

methods.name: resolveDmGroupAccessDecision
methods.description: Determines access decision (allow, block, pairing) based on group and DM policies and sender allowance.

methods.name: resolveDmGroupAccessWithLists
methods.description: Resolves access decision and effective allowlists using provided lists and policies.

methods.name: resolveDmGroupAccessWithCommandGate
methods.description: Resolves access with command gating logic, including command authorization and blocking.

methods.name: resolveDmAllowState
methods.description: Determines the allow state for a DM, including wildcard presence and allow count.
